PreToolUse.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python -c "import sys,json,re; inp=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=inp.get('command',''); exit(0 if not re.search(r'git push.*--force|git reset.*--hard|git clean.*-f|rm -rf', cmd) else (print('⛔ 危险操作被拦截：' + cmd[:80]) or 1))"
PreToolUse.description: 拦截危险 git 操作（force push / reset --hard / clean -f）

PostToolUse.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python -c "import sys,json; cmd=json.load(sys.stdin).get('command',''); exit(0)" 2>/dev/null; echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '"git commit' && python scripts/sync_project_state.py --no-test --quiet || true
PostToolUse.description: git commit 后自动同步管理文档（不重跑测试，由 pre-commit hook 负责）
